correctness.rationale: The all-orders proof is a disjoint exhaustive partition by clique counts of labels 2 and 3. Each regime translates the defining local conditions into necessary-and-sufficient label restrictions, producing the three polynomial terms. The weight-3 classification is independent of the polynomial algebra. verify.py exhaustively checks all 112896 labelings across (r,n) in {2,3,4}^2 and compares every coefficient, minimum, optimum count, and total count.

value.rationale: Complete split graphs are canonical threshold/split graphs, and the full weight distribution is a natural refinement of the well-studied minimum double Roman domination number. The exact three-regime structural classification yields every coefficient, the exact number of optimum functions, and the total number of feasible functions. This is materially stronger than recomputing the prior scalar value and supplies reusable structure for related join constructions.
